FAQ

Is there a free plan?
Yes. The Free plan includes one project, 10 daily keyword searches, and one site audit per month, enough to evaluate SeoTool.im before subscribing.
What happens when I hit my quota limit?
You’ll see a friendly upgrade prompt when you try to use a feature that’s exceeded its quota. Your existing data is never lost. Just upgrade or wait for the next reset window.
Can I upgrade or downgrade anytime?
Yes. Changes take effect immediately and your usage quotas reset to match the new plan. Billing is prorated through Stripe.
Do quotas reset?
Daily quotas (keyword searches, backlink checks) reset every day at midnight UTC. Monthly quotas (audits, AI scans, content intelligence) reset at the start of each billing cycle.
Can I cancel anytime?
Yes. Cancel from your billing page at any time. Your access continues through the end of the current billing period.
